interface.longDescription: Zodiac story production with semantic V4 visuals and Job@5 handoff.
interface.defaultPrompt: Follow skills/zodiac-video-pipeline/SKILL.md and orchestration/router.md. Three editorial phases: 01-content, 02-visual-production, 03-handoff. Before every step, derive the active step from persisted state and read its manifest-bounded references; never substitute remembered guidance or an ad-hoc checklist. Fresh episodes use character_deconstruction with episode formats single_sign, element_group, ranked_shortlist and comparison. Phase 01 is fail-closed: narration cannot begin until the compiled writer brief contains nonempty rhythm_direction and narrator_vibe, and Content Review cannot open until required narration artifacts and actual validator receipts exist. A user-revoked, deleted, discarded or explicitly excluded source remains ineligible even if the runtime remounts or resurfaces it; only an explicit later user re-authorization may restore it. Preserve sourced evidence, approved narration and genuine user reviews. Use only verified phase-scoped execution source; never let repository transport replace plugin routing or phase manifests. Preserve zodiac-job@5 producer/runner boundary; measured TTS, timing, Remotion, audio and MP4 QA stay with local runner. Fresh 2.6.8+ Phase 01 uses Engagement Design before drafting, progressive Narration preflight + draft checkpoint, then grounded Engagement Review; do not defer basic contract/duration/TTS/identity defects to final validation. Fresh 2.6.10+ Phase 02 requires intentional hair identity with co-visible diversity and a scene story-focus chain that binds focal/supporting entities to the semantic goal before native asset compilation; passive, decorative or unlinked story elements block Visual Review while intentionally sparse reflection/payoff scenes remain allowed with explicit rationale. Fresh 2.6.11+ includes per-scene checkpoint DAG, dependency-aware repair guidance and cross-scene continuity before native compilation; scene authoring QC never counts as native approval. Fresh 2.6.11+ adds a per-scene checkpoint DAG, dependency-aware repair and cross-scene continuity; authoring QC is not native approval. Phase 02 native scene-direction --write now uses isolated per-scene subprocesses, content-addressed cache, and aggregate production/receipt publishing; never run shared native writes concurrently or treat native receipt as creative approval. See references/scene-native-execution.md. Fresh 2.6.16+: before each Phase 02 asset selection read references/asset-library-v4/creative/README.md and creative/library-catalog.json. Reusable primitives are not story concepts. Unique symbolic Narrative Visuals and scene-specific transformations MUST be authored per episode and assessed with features/visual-composition/validate-creative-asset-provenance.mjs; do not replace them with stock metaphor templates. New reusable physical props are selected from props/index.json only when semantically appropriate. Never label a mechanical creative-provenance PASS as user Visual Review approval.
